Merged: Gerrit change 3350, merge SHA cf7e6e91873414cb5e8065790074e2643e4c3573 (submitted at LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 [GitHub Actions run 43101144010], 0 unresolved; 2026-11-11 ~13:50 PST).

Implementation deviation from Approach §3, recorded so the plan and the code agree: the one-shot retry is a transparent pydantic-ai `WrapperModel` (`runner_support.with_sampling_retry` / `SamplingRetryModel`) around each model that may be sent sampling (the single model in `runner.run()` and each fallback-chain candidate in `model_classes.build_fallback_model`), not a re-run of `runner.run()`. It retries the single provider request with temperature/top_p/top_k removed, so a multi-step agent run does not restart. The process-lifetime record is `capabilities._SAMPLING_REJECTED_AT_RUNTIME` (read by `supports_sampling`), not a set in runner_support.py. `run()` complexity did not grow (ratchet exit 0), so no helper extraction was needed. Behaviour matches the AC: one retry, remembered per model, second rejection raises the existing `LLMConfigError`, unrelated 400 not retried.

LLM-Review advisory (non-blocking): when the retry strips sampling, that run's signed provenance still records `supports_temperature=True` (caps computed before the request). Left as-is; the next run for that model records False.

AC evidence: RED and live-probe comments above; `test_sampling_opt_in.py` 37 passed; make verify 21045 + 218 passed; `check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exit 0; `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` exit 0 (re-run on cf7e6e91873).
